Cross-section
Integral flange joints

Sideways M3 bolts, shallow locating keys and a single rear hub. Seam hardware stays behind the reflecting face. Print the seam strips first.

Seam bolts clamp on flat seats with a loose nut. For inserts, use short M4 inserts (maximum 6 mm long in 7 mm blind pockets) and match your supplier’s pilot size.

Feed / secondary support

Use the feed’s actual phase center; zero is a placeholder.

Geometric prototype. Secondary size, diffraction and rear-feed clearance require RF validation.

Small bolted rim shoes, long metal rods and one round puck. Frequency sizes the secondary and sets screening tolerances; feed geometry sets the phase offset. RF feed not included.

Printer
Side printing

Flat radial flange on the bed. Add a brim in your slicer; preview every layer around the upper flange and pockets. No disposable supports generated.

Arrange print plates

Assign each copy to a plate and adjust X / Y in mm from bed center, or rotate on the bed. Side-print orientation stays fixed. Allow 6 mm between part bounds. Geometry changes reset arrangements.

3D model. Dimensions and downloads are available in the side panels.
